passives.name: EdwardAlphonseEquipmentPassive1
passives.description:
This unit’s attacks cycle through 3 attacks

$Understand:
On attack:
- Apply $AlchemyMark
  (Capacity: {1})
- $AlchemyMark will not be removed through each rotation

$Deconstruct:
On attack:
- Grants all units in range {2}% $Magical damage per $AlchemyMark applied
  (Capacity {3}% $Magical damage)
  For {7} seconds

$Reconstruct:
On attack:
- Deal {4}% of this unit’s current damage
- Apply {5}% $Slow for {6} seconds
